change.title: pr-80528-flat
change.description: ref(crons): Reorganize incident creation / issue occurrence logic
change.author: Cristian Sotomayor

findings.title: Computed `config` with display schedule_type is discarded
findings.body: `get_monitor_environment_context` builds a copy of the config and swaps `schedule_type` for its display value (lines 160-162). The returned dict then uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config` (line 168), so the copy is never used and the occurrence event gets the raw schedule_type. The old `mark_failed.py` had the same code, so moving it doesn't change behaviour. Since the function is now in its own module, either return `config` (this changes the event payload, and MonitorSerializer at src/sentry/monitors/serializers.py:240-242 does the same swap) or delete the dead lines. Doing it as a separate change would keep this refactor behaviour-neutral.

findings.title: Docstring typos and examples that don't match the output
findings.body: The docstring has typos ("humam readible"). Its examples don't match what the function returns. For example, it shows "3 missed check-ins detected" and "... were detected". The code returns "%(problem_checkins)s check-ins detected", and the singular strings are "A missed check-in was detected", not "A failed check-in was detected". The text was copied unchanged. Fix it while the code is being moved, if you like.

contracts.action: mark_failed now delegates incident/threshold handling to try_incident_threshold; occurrence creation moved to create_incident_occurrence in a new module
contracts.equivalent_path: Previously mark_failed_threshold and create_issue_platform_occurrence in mark_failed.py (same file, removed lines). Both were called by mark_failed with the same arguments (failed_checkin, failure_issue_threshold, received).
contracts.before_after: Before: mark_failed updated the env row, refreshed it from the DB, then called mark_failed_threshold. After: the same sequence, calling try_incident_threshold. The body compared line by line: status transition, SimpleCheckIn list building, the MonitorIncident get_or_create, the mute check, per-checkin occurrence creation, the monitor_environment_failed signal and the return values are identical. create_incident_occurrence and get_failure_reason are also identical. The only changes are the renames and SimpleCheckIn moving to monitors/types.py. No other module in src or tests imports the removed names (mark_failed_threshold, create_issue_platform_occurrence, get_failure_reason, SimpleCheckIn). The only importers of mark_failed are check_missed, check_timeout, monitor_consumer and tests, which use mark_failed itself.
contracts.visible_effect: None: the same incidents, issue occurrences and signal as before.
contracts.failure_mode: No new async calls, I/O or loops. The existing Kafka produce and DB calls are unchanged. The import graph is acyclic: mark_failed imports incidents, which imports incident_occurrence, which imports models and types. The lazy imports of sentry.signals and sentry.issues.producer are kept.

summary: This pull request is a behaviour-preserving refactor. It moves the threshold/incident logic into `logic/incidents.py` (as `try_incident_threshold`) and occurrence creation into `logic/incident_occurrence.py` (as `create_incident_occurrence`). It also moves `SimpleCheckIn` to `monitors/types.py`. The moved bodies match the removed code, and no references to the removed names remain in the repository. I found two low-severity items that were already in the code: `get_monitor_environment_context` computes a `config` copy and then returns the unmodified config, and the `get_failure_reason` docstring is inaccurate.
